Name: NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC-1:2018)
Description: The Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC-1:2018) were developed by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) of Saudi Arabia to set minimum cybersecurity requirements for Google Cloud Platform (GCP) workloads.

Requirements.Name: 1-4-1 Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity roles and service accounts must enforce least privilege and separation of duties.

Requirements.Name: 2-1-1 Asset Management & Inventory
Requirements.Description: Maintain automated inventory of all GCP assets using Cloud Asset Inventory.

Requirements.Name: 2-5-1 Network Security Management
Requirements.Description: VPC firewall rules must prohibit unrestricted ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 on sensitive ports.

Requirements.Name: 2-7-1 Data and Information Protection
Requirements.Description: Cloud Storage buckets and Cloud SQL instances must enforce encryption with Customer-Managed Keys (CMEK) and uniform bucket-level access.

Requirements.Name: 2-8-1 Cryptography and Key Management
Requirements.Description: Cloud KMS keys must have automatic rotation configured and access separated.

Requirements.Name: 2-12-1 Event Logs and Monitoring Management
Requirements.Description: Cloud Audit logging and metric alerts must be enabled for security-critical configuration changes.
